Based in Dubai, Al Sheikh Investment Group brings together specialist businesses in energy, real estate, precious materials and international trade.

Our strength is in our connections. Across sectors and borders, we work with partners to create lasting value through shared expertise and a long-term perspective.

Kussay Al Sheikh

President & Chairman

Kussay Al Sheikh leads Al Sheikh Investment Group with experience spanning real estate, petroleum and precious materials. His business journey began in 1997, laying the foundation for an outlook that connects industries, markets and people.

Today, that perspective informs the group’s commitment to partnerships, responsible growth and the opportunities ahead.
